title: IPIP Trust — 10 items
source: International Personality Item Pool, preliminary NEO-like facet A1: Trust. IPIP item set, not the proprietary NEO-PI-R instrument.
license: Public domain; commercial and non-commercial use permitted by IPIP.
limitations: Self-description responses only, not observed trust behavior. Overlaps with other IPIP scales; not an independent validation of their findings.
instruction: Indicate how accurately the following statement describes you as you generally are now. Respond as yourself, not as a fictional character. Each statement completes: I...

items.text: Believe that others have good intentions.
Believe that people are basically moral.
Think that all will be well.
Believe that people are essentially evil.
